title: Hardik Pandya's Ex-Wife Natasa Stankovic Trolled For Bringing Son To Fashion Show: 'Not Age-Appropriate'- N
summary: Natasa Stankovic faced online criticism after bringing her son Agastya to the front row of a Mumbai fashion show. A viral video showing model Aleksandar Alex affectionately tending to the child sparked debate over whether such events are age-appropriate. Supporters defended Natasa while speculation about her personal life and her separation from cricketer Hardik Pandya resurfaced.
content:
Hardik Pandya’s ex-wife Natasa Stankovic was trolled online after allowing her son, Agastya, to sit in the front row at a fashion show in Mumbai. The actress walked the ramp at the event, while her son was seated in the audience beside Aleksandar Alex. Aleksandar, who is a model and fitness coach, was seen affectionately caring for Agastya and at one point kissed him on the head; a video of the moment has since gone viral.

The footage prompted mixed reactions. Some viewers criticised the decision to bring a young child to a fashion event, with one commenter writing, "Why to bring kids to such events ? Just because her mother is walking the ramp? The kid has no idea ki ho kya raha hai ?" Another wrote, "As much as I support Natasa, the fashion show is not age-appropriate for her son." Others defended her, saying she appears to be taking good care of Agastya and that the presence of a caring family friend mitigated concerns.

There has been additional online speculation about Natasa's relationship with Aleksandar Alex, though several users claimed he is actually her cousin. The incident also revived public interest in Natasa's personal life and her past marriage to Indian cricketer Hardik Pandya. Natasa and Hardik married in May 2020 during the COVID-19 lockdown and later held a larger wedding celebration in February 2023 in Udaipur. Their son, Agastya, was born in July 2020.

In July 2024, Natasa and Hardik announced their separation in an official statement, saying they had "decided to mutually part ways" after four years together and that it was a "tough decision." They confirmed they would continue to co-parent their son, emphasizing mutual respect as they move forward. The fashion-show episode and the viral video have simply added to the ongoing public conversation about the family's post-separation life and Natasa's parenting choices.

content.content:
Hardik Pandya’s ex’wife Natasa Stankovic is being trolled online for allowing her son, Agastya, to sit in the front row at a fashion show in Mumbai, with many claiming it’s not age-appropriate. The actress walked the ramp at the event on Saturday, while her son was seated in the audience alongside Aleksandar Alex. Aleksandar, who is both a model and fitness coach, was seen affectionately caring for Agastya—at one point even kissing him on the head—sparking a wave of reactions online. A video of the moment has since gone viral. While there has been speculation that Natasa and Aleksandar are dating, several Instagram users have claimed that he is actually her cousin brother.

A netizen took to the comments section to write, “Why to bring kids to such events ? Just because her mother is walking the ramp? The kid has no idea ki ho kya raha hai ?" Another wrote, “As much as I support Natasa, the fashion show is not age-appropriate for her son." Many also rallied behind her and said that she’s taking good care of the son.

A post shared by Instant Bollywood (@instantbollywood)

Natasa Stankovic and cricketer Hardik Pandya got married in May 2020 during the COVID-19 lockdown. They later had a grand wedding celebration in February 2023 in Udaipur, where they renewed their vows. The couple has a son named Agastya, who was born in July 2020. Over the years, they have shared many happy moments together on social media. However, there were rumours about problems in their marriage, especially since Natasa has been seen without Hardik at several events.

In July 2024, Natasa and Hardik announced separation. The couple issued an official statement and confirmed that they are no longer together. They mentioned that it was a “tough decision" for both of them and shared that they will continue to co-parent their 3-year-old son, Agastya.

“After 4 years of being together, Hardik and I have decided to mutually part ways. We tried our best together and gave it our all, and we believe this is in the best interest for the both of us. This was a tough decision for us to make, given the joy, mutual respect and companionship we enjoyed together and as we grew a family," the statement read.
